sentences.en: The results of the term examination were anything but satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 期中考试的结果令人非常不满意。

sentences.en: Too many irons in the fire result in bad workmanship.
sentences.zh: 太多项目在手会导致产品质量差。

sentences.en: An apparently small event may lead to a great result.
sentences.zh: 一件看似微不足道的事情可能会带来巨大的结果。
